defaults.note: trainerproc applies these when a mon omits the line; an IVs line patches only the stats it names, so "IVs: 0 Atk" is 31/0/31/31/31/31. A null abilityConstant means trainerproc emitted no .ability, leaving the species default.

AI_FLAG_CHECK_BAD_MOVE.gloss: AI will avoid using moves that are likely to fail or be ineffective in the current situation.

AI_FLAG_TRY_TO_FAINT.gloss: AI will prioritize KOing the player's mon if able.

AI_FLAG_CHECK_VIABILITY.gloss: AI damaging moves and move effects to determine the best available move in the current situation.

AI_FLAG_FORCE_SETUP_FIRST_TURN.gloss: AI will prioritize using setup moves on the first turn at the expensve of all else. AI_FLAG_CHECK_VIABILITY will instead do this when the AI determines it makes sense.

AI_FLAG_RISKY.gloss: AI will generally behave more recklessly, prioritizing damage over accuracy, explosions, etc.

AI_FLAG_TRY_TO_2HKO.gloss: AI adds score bonus to any move the AI has that either OHKOs or 2HKOs the player.

AI_FLAG_PREFER_BATON_PASS.gloss: AI prefers raising its own stats and setting for / using Baton Pass.

AI_FLAG_DOUBLE_BATTLE.gloss: Automatically set for double battles, handles AI behaviour with partner.

AI_FLAG_HP_AWARE.gloss: AI will favour certain move effects based on how much remaining HP it and the player's mon have.

AI_FLAG_POWERFUL_STATUS.gloss: AI prefers moves that set up field effects or side statuses, even if the user can faint the target.

AI_FLAG_NEGATE_UNAWARE.gloss: AI is NOT aware of negating effects like wonder room, mold breaker, etc.

AI_FLAG_WILL_SUICIDE.gloss: AI will use explosion / self destruct / final gambit / etc.

AI_FLAG_PREFER_STATUS_MOVES.gloss: AI gets a score bonus for status moves. Should be combined with AI_FLAG_CHECK_BAD_MOVE to prevent using only status moves.

AI_FLAG_STALL.gloss: AI stalls battle and prefers secondary damage/trapping/etc. TODO not finished.

AI_FLAG_SMART_SWITCHING.gloss: AI includes a lot more switching checks. Automatically includes AI_FLAG_SMART_MON_CHOICES.

AI_FLAG_ACE_POKEMON.gloss: AI has an Ace Pokemon. The last Pokemon in the party will not be used until it's the last one remaining.

AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT.gloss: AI has full knowledge of player moves, abilities, hold items.

AI_FLAG_SMART_MON_CHOICES.gloss: AI will make smarter decisions when choosing which mon to send out mid-battle and after a KO, which are separate decisions. Automatically included by AI_FLAG_SMART_SWITCHING.

AI_FLAG_CONSERVATIVE.gloss: AI assumes all moves will low roll damage.

AI_FLAG_SEQUENCE_SWITCHING.gloss: AI switches in mons in exactly party order, and never switches mid-battle.

AI_FLAG_DOUBLE_ACE_POKEMON.gloss: AI has *two* Ace Pokémon. The last two Pokémons in the party won't be used unless they're the last ones remaining. Goes well in battles where the trainer ID equals to twins, couples, etc.

AI_FLAG_WEIGH_ABILITY_PREDICTION.gloss: AI will predict player's ability based on aiRating

AI_FLAG_PREFER_HIGHEST_DAMAGE_MOVE.gloss: AI adds score to highest damage move regardless of accuracy or secondary effect

AI_FLAG_PREDICT_SWITCH.gloss: AI will predict the player's switches and switchins based on how it would handle the situation. Recommend using AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT

AI_FLAG_PREDICT_INCOMING_MON.gloss: AI will score against the predicting incoming mon if it predicts the player to switch. Requires AI_FLAG_PREDICT_SWITCH

AI_FLAG_PP_STALL_PREVENTION.gloss: AI keeps track of the player's switches where the incoming mon is immune to the chosen move

AI_FLAG_PREDICT_MOVE.gloss: AI will predict the player's move based on what move it would use in the same situation. Recommend using AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT

AI_FLAG_SMART_TERA.gloss: AI will make smarter decisions when choosing whether to terrastalize (default is to always tera whenever available).

AI_FLAG_ASSUME_STAB.gloss: AI knows player's STAB moves, but nothing else. Restricted version of AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT.

AI_FLAG_ASSUME_STATUS_MOVES.gloss: AI has a chance to know certain non-damaging moves, and also Fake Out and Super Fang. Restricted version of AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT.

AI_FLAG_ATTACKS_PARTNER.gloss: AI specific to double battles; AI can deliberately attack its 'partner.'

AI_FLAG_KNOW_OPPONENT_PARTY.gloss: AI knows all the species in the player's party, but not moves/items/abilities unless they've been seen.

AI_FLAG_RANDOMIZE_SWITCHIN.gloss: AI will randomly choose between eligible switchin candidates of a given category instead of picking the last one in the party.

AI_FLAG_RANDOMIZE_PARTY_INDICES.gloss: AI will randomize the order of the mons in its party, including the lead. Not an AI flag really, just a way to trigger TPP functionality

AI_FLAG_DYNAMIC_FUNC.gloss: Create custom AI functions for specific battles via "setdynamicaifunc" cmd
